# up octosql

Pin `octosql` at v0.6.0 in the Go toolset. `octosql` was added as a "SQL for everything" experiment ([#97](DOT-96.md)); the tools are installed by `go generate` over [tools.go](../../toolset/tools.go) from the versions pinned in [toolset/go.mod](../../toolset/go.mod), so the upgrade is a change of that pin. The release notes are the [v0.6.0 tag](https://github.com/cube2222/octosql/releases/tag/v0.6.0).
